Extremely bad experience
Sep 2023 • Family
I've eaten here many times, the food quality is ok, but today in the plate of stir-fried udon noodles with beef, there was a strand of zinc (like in a dishwashing sponge). My family has a 5-year-old baby who could eat 2 strands, I can eat them. 2 chopsticks, I called the staff over, the staff took my plate straight to the kitchen, 2 minutes later came back and said let me stir-fry another plate for her. I agreed because I'm also an easy-going customer and don't want to make things difficult for anyone, but until I paid to go home, I still didn't receive a single apology from the chef or staff or manager. Does this happen often so you should take it lightly? Or do you think that re-frying a plate of noodles means the guest doesn't need to apologize?
I will never come back to this restaurant because the staff's attitude is so bad!
